Back of the toolshed in the yard. Maya kneeling on the dirt behind the shed, Frank standing with his back to the shed wall, his belt loose. Out of sight from the house. Sound of cicadas.

She catches his hand. Pulls him around the back of the toolshed where the kitchen window can't see. He doesn't fight her. The shed's between them and the house.

Frank: Maya —

She drops to her knees on the dirt before he finishes the word. His belt's loose by the time her hand finds him. She works him fast. The cicadas are loud enough to cover whatever sound he doesn't quite swallow.
